howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fill out the form with your details, dates, approximate budget and the type of trip you fancy.
howItWorks.step1Detail: With this information I analyze your tastes, needs and budget viability to propose the best options.
howItWorks.step2Desc: I prepare a document with a personalized proposal of destinations, sample flights and accommodations adjusted to your budget.
howItWorks.step2Detail: You review the proposal at your own pace and, if needed, we adjust details until it fits you.
howItWorks.step3Title: 3. Choose and pay for the package
howItWorks.step3Desc: Once you give the "Ok", you choose the package you like best and make the payment for my consultancy services, as you pay for my time and work hours, not hidden commissions.
howItWorks.step4Title: 4. I accompany you through the booking process
howItWorks.step4Desc: I don't manage payments, bookings or personal data on your behalf; you make the bookings directly with airlines, accommodations and providers.
howItWorks.step4Detail: I act as an intermediary and advise you: I provide links, recommended options and the best tips so you can book safely, simply and as cheaply as possible.
howItWorks.step5Title: 5. Your visual itinerary and… let's travel!
howItWorks.step5Desc: Once you have everything booked, within approximately 5 to 7 working days I prepare your trip in visual format, with the day-by-day itinerary, maps, recommendations and extras according to the chosen package.
howItWorks.step5Detail: Once you receive your final trip, the adventure begins: you'll continue to have my support and advice so you enjoy your experience to the fullest, but remember! We are not an agency, we are a consultancy.
